WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-12 11:30 to 2026-11-13 11:30 UTC
Paused: 2 reports unacknowledged. Receive in a session or react 👍 to resume. (The 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12 reports carry no reaction.)

1. Decisions for you: four, unchanged, nothing new this cycle (each is a proposed decision in the group log).
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 14 days): srs#1016 landed on 9 Nov, so it may be answered in practice. Recommendation: rule on it or close it as overtaken. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 14 days): one rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Recommendation: one rule, after a downstream audit. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 9 days): recommendation: route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 16 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Recommendation: approve. Action: decide. Urgency: low.

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified this cycle. No PR merged, so no quorum comment names a proposed decision; no group session was held.

3. Done: 0 PRs merged. Issues still open that should close with their landed PRs: srs-rust#1622, #1505, #1411, #728, #731, srs#928.

4. Stuck or lost: nothing merged in 24 hours because the group is paused (the builder opens nothing new and `clerk upkeep` merges no group PRs). Open group PRs (4), none changed since the last report:
- srs#1021 docs, three relation-layer statements (#1018): approved twice (latest 12 Nov 17:53, head 880ab3a), labelled `gate:auto-merge`, no auto-merge armed, state `unstable`. Waits on the merge step.
- srs-rust#1640 publish srs-bindings to npm (#819): approved, gates green, behind master. Waits on the merge step.
- srs-rust#1646 render composition --section (#1510): reviewer rejected, gate red (`site/public/cli` out of date; behind master). Builder's to fix.
- srs-web#782 type subtypes from the core (#336): rejected, merge conflict on `scripts/ensure-bindings.mjs`. Needs a rebase.
Stops (needs-input): srs-rust#1495, #1164, #731, srs-web#691 (waits on bc6bc746), srs-web#632. No red gates reported by runs. Merged PRs without a quorum line: none. Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: none found.

5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 4 open. Pause state: paused: 2 reports unacknowledged.
5b. Awaiting ratification: the four proposed decisions in section 1 are the only pending ones. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: open `ready` + `wg:third-party-ready` issues (not PRs): srs 7, srs-rust 11, srs-web 1, srs-vscode 0, semanticops.com 0 (19 in all; some are blocked or already landed). Top 3 in builder order (all P2, oldest first, skipping stopped and landed ones): srs-rust#1339, srs-rust#1510 (PR in flight), srs#1022. Local priorities: none set. Queue fed for about 2 cycles at 10 a day, but nothing builds while paused. Waits on the owner: the four decisions above and a 👍 or a session to unpause. Fed by the analyst: 2026-11-11 (filed 10 rulings, unparked 4).

6b. Exercises: not re-read this cycle; the open ones in the last report stand (2d521997, 3956749c, b032e064, 6f3839be, c636bb69, 920ab2a5, 7131fe89).

7. What we learned: the pause rule did what it was written for, and the cost is visible: a fed queue (19 ready) and two approved, green PRs sit unmerged for a day because the reports were not acknowledged. Whether a 24-hour pause is the right price is the owner's to judge. Build trigger (about 10 ratified decisions across both logs, then srs-web#560): not counted exactly, not flagged. Measurement I1: 0 of 0 PRs merged in the window grounded (the window opens at the 11:30 `cycleStart` read at the close, so it is empty); result 4df3b198-e302-485f-8ef4-30ea33366cf8 (records/tier-2/measurement-result-4df3b198.json). Whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
